selected_evidence.summary: The group exists and final stat output shows `/srv/releases` owned by `root:release-team` with mode `2775` (`drwxrwsr-x`).

selected_evidence.requirement: Newly created files inherit the workspace group
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after restart, files created by root (primary group `root`) were directly shown with group `release-team`.

Healthy baseline used boot ID `ab09f655-9d2b-4574-a072-db67e58266c2`; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to `9f916bb5-c46f-40bf-9aea-c47dcfd3f016`; the system returned to `running` with zero failed units, unchanged probe checksum/content, correct workspace metadata, and working group inheritance.

commands.command:
set -eu
i=0
while :; do
  state=$(systemctl is-system-running 2>&1 || true)
  if [ "$state" = running ]; then
    break
  fi
  i=$((i + 1))
  if [ "$i" -ge 20 ]; then
    printf 'system did not reach running state: %s\n' "$state" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  sleep 2
done
old_boot=ab09f655-9d2b-4574-a072-db67e58266c2
current_boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
test "$current_boot" != "$old_boot"
test "$(stat -c %G /srv/releases)" = release-team
test "$(stat -c %a /srv/releases)" = 2775
test "$(stat -c %G /srv/releases/.[REDACTED])" = release-team
test "$(sha256sum /srv/releases/.[REDACTED] | awk '{print $1}')" = 07612a5dbcd3b632dba84e17888cccfac23014c3c481889e8c3b91af3f29cc5d
post_probe=/srv/releases/.[REDACTED]
if [ -e "$post_probe" ]; then
  printf 'unexpected existing probe: %s\n' "$post_probe" >&2
  exit 1
fi
umask 022
printf '%s\n' 'post-restart-setgid-inheritance-probe-v1' > "$post_probe"
test "$(stat -c %G "$post_probe")" = release-team
printf 'post_restart_boot_id=%s\n' "$current_boot"
printf 'system_state=%s\n' "$state"
printf 'failed_unit_count='; systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain | wc -l
printf 'creator_primary_group='; id -gn
getent group release-team
stat -c 'workspace mode=%a symbolic=%A owner=%U group=%G path=%n' /srv/releases
stat -c 'persisted_file mode=%a owner=%U group=%G size=%s path=%n' /srv/releases/.[REDACTED]
sha256sum /srv/releases/.[REDACTED]
printf 'persisted_content='; cat /srv/releases/.[REDACTED]
stat -c 'post_restart_new_file mode=%a owner=%U group=%G size=%s path=%n' "$post_probe"
